identityAndSchema: Stable entity id, environment id, schemaVersion and local revision exist on the Device Store record; hubRevision is null until 31D. Project membership is workspace scoped.

storage: Device Store records entity_type=pipeline + outbox (journaled); legacy mirror dude:v1:__pipelines__:saved
sensitivity: definition non-sensitive; referenced scripts can contain secrets
identityAndSchema: Stable entity id, environment id, schemaVersion and local revision exist on the Device Store record; hubRevision is null until 31D.

storage: Device Store records entity_type=user-script + outbox (journaled); legacy mirror dude:v1:user-scripts:library
sensitivity: body may contain secrets or executable content
identityAndSchema: Stable entity id, environment id, schemaVersion and local revision exist on the Device Store record; hubRevision is null until 31D. A shared definition never promotes script body or execution permission.

storage: Device Store records entity_type=workspace-layout (scope workspace)
sensitivity: tool IDs and UI choices; overrides require per-key review
identityAndSchema: Stable entity id, environment id, schemaVersion and local revision exist on the Device Store record; hubRevision is null until 31D.

retention: none is memory; session lasts browser session; local until removed/reset; user-choice local only after existing retention consent

storage: Device Store kv key dude:v1:__consent__:<toolId>:<key> (scope device)
identityAndSchema: Local retention permission is never synchronization permission.

retention: 200 per tool, 5000 global, 90 days, 256 KiB per entry, enforced in the same transaction as each write; existing oversized-entry preview handling

storage: Device Store network_runs (SQLite) on desktop; IndexedDB dude:v1:network-history on web

Device Store device_docs row window-bounds

Device Store device_docs row remembered-folders; live grants remain memory
retention: remembered folders until forgotten; existing grant lifetime

storage: Device Store mutation_journal (engine fs) and device_docs row fs-mutation-settings; backups stay on disk
retention: existing configurable policy; defaults 30 days and 5 GiB backups

storage: Device Store mutation_journal (engine sys), device_docs row sys-mutation-settings; backups stay on disk
sensitivity: sensitive system values and undo data

storage: Device Store snapshot_headers (headers); snapshot bodies stay on disk
sensitivity: sensitive absolute paths and file hashes

storage: Device Store snapshot_headers (headers); snapshot bodies stay on disk
Device Store device_docs row watched-folders; watch timeline and opt-in content copies on disk
retention: existing folder watch settings and content policy

storage: Device Store powershell_history; versioned catalog cache on disk
retention: existing MAX_HISTORY cap; catalog caches by version
sensitivity: execution metadata; no script text in history

storage: Device Store device_docs rows hotkey-bindings, quick-launcher-hotkey, smart-paste-hotkey
Device Store device_docs row certificate-watch-list

sensitivity: layout definitions; overrides need per-key review
identityAndSchema: Stable entity id, environment id, schemaVersion and local revision exist on the Device Store record; hubRevision is null until 31D.

retention: local until reset/changed; existing reset-content choice applies
sensitivity: mixed presentation definitions, arbitrary panel config and user-authored content

storage: Device Store records entity_type=favorite + outbox (environment, journaled); legacy mirror dude:v1:__favorites__:pinned
identityAndSchema: Stable entity id, environment id, schemaVersion and local revision exist on the Device Store record; hubRevision is null until 31D. Pipeline references point to workspace pipeline ids.

storage: Device Store kv settings:appearance (setting definition, environment, journaled as entity setting); prepaint mirror in localStorage
identityAndSchema: Stable entity id, environment id, schemaVersion and local revision exist on the Device Store record; hubRevision is null until 31D.

storage: userData/device-store/dude-device.db (WAL, synchronous=FULL), backups/ and quarantine/ beside it
retention: until reset; pre-upgrade backups kept per maintenance policy
identityAndSchema: Tables: meta, schema_migrations, kv, records, outbox, history_entries, network_runs, mutation_journal, snapshot_headers, powershell_history, device_docs, secret_refs, secret_values. kv and records carry a per-row scope (see data-scope-inventory.json); records and outbox carry entity id, environment id and local revision.

storage: Device Store meta (device_id, display_name, machine hash/salt, cloned_from); web installation id record in browser storage
retention: for the life of the store; a clone gets a new deviceId and records the old one
sensitivity: opaque identifiers; machine hash is salted
identityAndSchema: Device id is minted once per store; never derived from hardware identifiers in plaintext.

storage: Device Store meta environment_id; stamped on records and outbox operations
retention: for the life of the store
identityAndSchema: Environment id names the user environment a record belongs to; enrollment into a Hub environment is 31C/31D.

storage: Device Store outbox (UNIQUE per entity, coalesced)
retention: until drained or reset; durable across hard kill
identityAndSchema: Operations carry op id, entity id, environment id, device id, schemaVersion, local revision and null basedOnRevision. Nothing is transmitted before explicit 31D consent.

storage: Device Store records entity_type=usage (environment, journaled); legacy mirror dude:v1:__usage__:activity
sensitivity: activity metadata; sync-eligible only after explicit 31D consent
identityAndSchema: Stable entity id, environment id, schemaVersion and local revision exist on the Device Store record; hubRevision is null until 31D.

storage: Device Store kv __workspace__:reopenOnRestart (environment, journaled as entity setting)
Device Store records entity_type=native-recents
Device Store device_docs row ai-provider (baseUrl, model); web: kv settings.ai
Device Store secret_refs + secret_values (encrypted), referenced by SecretRef from setting settings.ai:apiKey
identityAndSchema: The value never returns to the renderer after save and never enters records, outbox or exports; a cloned store marks references needsReentry.

storage: Device Store device_docs (loadDoc/saveDoc)
identityAndSchema: Desktop documents (preferences, window bounds, hotkeys, grants, watch lists, mutation settings); legacy JSON files imported once.
